description: This file implements the PocketAccountMappingReadPlatformService interface for retrieving and validating pocket account mappings within the Fineract project. It interacts with repositories and performs database queries to fetch and validate account data related to user pockets.

classes.name: PocketAccountMappingReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for reading pocket account mapping data and validating account-pockets relationships, using repositories and JDBC template.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all pocket account mappings for the currently authenticated user, categorized by account type (loan, savings, share).

methods.name: validatePocketAndAccountMapping
methods.description: Validates if a specific account is mapped to a pocket with a given account type by executing a SQL count query.
